resources.capability: Managed static content hosting with HTTPS
controls: No server runtime or durable local state

assumptions.decision: Use the Free tier for a low-traffic demonstration
assumptions.evidence: The workload is a personal demonstration with no production SLA
assumptions.revisitTrigger: Traffic, custom-domain, or production requirements exceed Free-tier capabilities

reliability: Accept the sandbox service limits and redeploy from source if recovery is needed
security: Use managed HTTPS and expose only public static content
costOptimization: Use the Free tier and avoid unused compute, databases, and private networking
operationalExcellence: Deploy from checked-in source through a repeatable dry-run-validated workflow
performanceEfficiency: Use the managed static content edge and measure asset size before adding another CDN

tradeoffs.decision: Use sandbox hosting without a separate enterprise edge
tradeoffs.benefit: Minimal fixed cost and operational overhead
tradeoffs.cost: No enterprise WAF or custom global failover topology
tradeoffs.revisitTrigger: The site becomes a production business endpoint

validation.check: Compile the TypeScript provisioning entrypoint and complete an iac-compose dry run
Verify Microsoft.Web provider registration and regional Static Web Apps availability
